## Change summary

Describe what changes and why.

## Verification

List exact tests, CI jobs, screenshots, logs or other evidence used to verify this change. Distinguish verified facts from assumptions or pending checks.

## Values Gate

- [ ] **Truth** — status/evidence is accurate and material unknowns are visible.
- [ ] **Possibility** — reasonable alternatives were explored before declaring a path impossible.
- [ ] **One** — this does not silently optimize GadgetBuddy at the expense of another Pihlonme project/team.
- [ ] **Challenge** — material objections, Red Team findings and contradictory evidence were considered.
- [ ] **Learning** — relevant failures/lessons are preserved as regression coverage, documentation or follow-up action.
- [ ] **Safety** — privacy, security, legal, authorization, secret-handling and rollback risks are acceptable.
- [ ] **Ownership** — owner and next action are explicit.

**Values Gate result:** PASS | PASS_WITH_ACTIONS | BLOCKED

For `PASS_WITH_ACTIONS`, list each follow-up action and owner below. `BLOCKED` means do not merge/release. No gate result may override law, safety, privacy, security, secret-handling or explicit authorization boundaries.

## Governance

This project follows `GOVERNANCE.md`, which adopts the canonical Pihlonme Koncern Governance maintained in `pihlonme/Pihlonme-Os`.
